title: Vicunav - Contact EN
form:
[text* contact-name id:vicunav-contact-en-name autocomplete:name placeholder "Full name"]
[email* contact-email id:vicunav-contact-en-email autocomplete:email placeholder "Email address"]
[select* contact-practice id:vicunav-contact-en-practice "Coach or consultant" "Therapist or mental health professional" "Wellness or lifestyle professional" "Trainer or educator" "Independent professional" "Small service business" "Other"]
[select* contact-website id:vicunav-contact-en-website "Yes" "No"]
[select contact-situation id:vicunav-contact-en-situation "I am starting from scratch" "My current website no longer reflects my work" "I need more clarity and structure" "I am not sure yet, but I feel stuck" "Other"]
[select contact-next-step id:vicunav-contact-en-next-step "I would like to schedule a discovery call" "I prefer to start with written guidance"]
[textarea contact-help id:vicunav-contact-en-help 40x4 placeholder "Write here..."]
[textarea contact-context id:vicunav-contact-en-context 40x5 placeholder "Write here..."]
[turnstile appearance:interaction-only size:flexible theme:light language:en]
[submit "SEND"]
